definition: A group of three people sharing power or responsibility.
author: Charles Dickens
quote: But, he feigned not to notice the two strangers, and fell into discourse with the triumvirate of customers who were drinking at the counter.
example_sentence: The school was run by a triumvirate of strict head teachers.
